technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish but intermediate trend weak; price below key 50-day MAs and Ichimoku cloud with negative MACD histogram creates conflicting signals unsuitable for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 37 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction (2 small purchases vs 1 sale, 84-98 days old) and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (381.44), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event in 37 days adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish, ADX trending, Parabolic SAR bullish) combined with extreme fear sentiment (14/100) and contrarian buy signal creates asymmetric risk/reward for patient entry near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below critical 50-day MAs and Ichimoku cloud with negative MACD histogram, zero fundamental catalysts, severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, rising USD, flat yield curve), and earnings binary event in 37 days make this a high-risk, low-probability swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term structure remains bullish with trend-following indicators aligned, and extreme fear sentiment (14/100) presents contrarian opportunity. However, price trapped below 50-day MAs with negative MACD histogram and zero fundamental catalysts make this unsuitable for swing entry at current levels.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 37 days combined with severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, rising USD, flat yield curve) creates uncompensated downside risk with no institutional accumulation to support entry.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias despite long-term bullish structure
